description: Income tax on a CHF 100,000 gross salary in every Swiss commune (federal + cantonal + communal, no church tax, no wealth), from the official ESTV tax calculator, for two households: single (35) and married couple with two children. Ranks the communes of a canton or Switzerland. For a specific income, wealth or household in one commune use commune_tax.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Lists every commune of the canton.

commune.description: Swiss commune: official name, BFS number or 4-digit postcode, e.g. "Winterthur", "230" or "8400". «8001 Zürich» and «Basel (BS)» also work.

household.description: single (35, no children) or family (married couple with two children).

name: tax_by_commune
title: Tax on CHF 100,000 by commune
